verdict: Content distribution to a DP failed because required IIS 6 WMI Compatibility components are missing on the DP. DistMgr cannot read DP config via WMI without them.
fix: On the DP server, open `Server Manager -> Manage -> Add Roles and Features`. Under `Web Server (IIS) -> Management Tools -> IIS 6 Management Compatibility`, install `IIS 6 Metabase Compatibility` AND `IIS 6 WMI Compatibility`. Both are required. Restart `SMSExec` on the primary site server; content distribution will retry automatically.
